milestone.title: Playable semantic interiors and reliable traversal loop

acceptance_criteria: InteriorPlan deterministically validates residential and retail manifests across the canonical and alternate seeds
Every eligible building has canonical use metadata, required rooms, a service/toilet room per floor, and a connected room graph

Bed/rest changes fatigue once without advancing time; retail storage grants exactly one allowed item and persists consumption
Internal/exterior door physics preserve closed blocking and open-leaf collision while allowing the aperture to be traversed
The no-teleport walkthrough enters, traverses rooms, climbs every storey, reaches the roof, returns, exits, closes, and re-blocks the entrance
City runtime proves deterministic entity ownership, floor-gate behavior, streaming, and save/load persistence for doors and stations

architectural_decisions: CityPlan is pure and immutable; chunks materialize deterministic geometry
Buildings have stable global IDs and belong to their footprint-center chunk
Visual facade details must not become a substitute for gameplay milestones
AUTOPILOT_STATE.json is canonical project-control state; Kanban is execution state; Git is implementation state
InteriorPlan is pure and deterministic; BuildingBuilder owns static room geometry; ChunkBuilder owns dynamic doors/stations
Existing Door, ChunkManager, WorldState, InteriorProbe, and ParkourController contracts are extended additively rather than replaced
Only residential and retail interior programs are authorized in this milestone; facade cosmetics and new autoloads are prohibited
